items.name: Fetch-Glass Pendant
items.lore: A little mirror that shows you a moment late. You get used to it.

items.name: Sorcha's Comb-Pin
items.lore: A comb of white bone. The fetch carried it; it is the only thing of hers it took.

items.name: Bocan-Hide Bracer
items.lore: The bocan are goblins of the cliffs. This one's hide is tough as boot-leather.

items.name: Cliff-Walker's Cloak
items.lore: Grey wool, weighted at the hem against the cliff wind.

items.name: Koalinth-Scale Token
items.lore: A blue-green scale, pierced and hung on a cord. The koalinth give them to children they claim.

items.name: Pact-Breaker's Ring
items.lore: Cut from the koalinth tide-caller's own hand.

items.name: Tide-Caller Mantle
items.lore: Woven of kelp and something finer. Water runs off it like off a seal.
